scenarios.cut: inside NEW_SOURCE advanced_search_sr PublishStagedImportRun after authoritative publication writes but before ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile enqueue/commit, plus cancellation/recovery of the source-check claim after an earlier handler checkpoint but before fresh publication begins, plus a still-current source-check claim whose current persisted checkpoint names another run/revision/candidate
scenarios.prove: committed replay is resolved before mutable claim reads; every fresh publication UnitOfWork calls DurableJobCoordinator.assert_claim_current before its receipt and consumes the exact current validated checkpoint returned from that same UoW; a cancelled/recovered/replaced claim returns JOB_CLAIM_CONFLICT, while a current claim whose returned checkpoint is null, not phase=publishing, or disagrees with the exact import_run_id/run_revision/parser_profile_id/candidate_identity fails publication before receipt with no publication evidence/proposals/audit/job enqueue; claim.checkpoint_json cannot substitute for the current witness; after a valid claim+checkpoint witness the one NEW_SOURCE publication UoW still rolls back run publication/evidence/proposals/receipt/audit and durable-job enqueue together on later failure, so no failed/unpublished evidence can clear an LLD-03 disappearance warning; CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT and OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED publication paths are separately proven not to enqueue automatic reappearance work

scenarios.cut: inside one sr_reappearance_reconcile per-SR internal command after outer receipt or LLD-03 event insert but before audit/result/commit, plus cancellation/recovery/reclaim of the worker claim after a prior page checkpoint but before a fresh per-SR command
scenarios.prove: committed per-SR replay is resolved before mutable claim reads; every fresh per-SR command calls DurableJobCoordinator.assert_claim_current inside its own owner UnitOfWork before the receipt, so revoked/replaced claims cannot clear a warning; after a valid claim the command rolls back receipt/event/audit/result atomically on later failure, durable job checkpoint does not advance past the failed SR, restart retries safely and exact command replay prevents duplicate reappearance events

source_check retries only JOB_INTERRUPTED, IMPORT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, IMPORT_FILE_UNSTABLE, IMPORT_PARSER_RESTARTABLE or PERSISTENCE_BUSY; sr_reappearance_reconcile retries only JOB_INTERRUPTED, PERSISTENCE_BUSY or bounded per-SR IMPORT_PROPOSAL_STALE; retryable attempt 1 requires retry_at=now+5 and attempt 2 requires retry_at=now+30; retryable attempt >=3 is terminal; every other stable failure code is terminal with retry_at=null; stale prior-run crash recovery uses the same 5/30/terminal attempt budget with JOB_INTERRUPTED; both Beta-1.0 job contracts reject every queued/running/waiting_review/retry_wait packet cancellation transition because no persisted Cancel Import command exists; Foundation ALREADY_CANCELLED/TERMINAL_UNCHANGED observations for terminal jobs are mutation-free no-ops that bypass packet cancellation policy and create no cancellation authority; cooperative host quiesce interruption and Foundation restore invalidation remain separate mechanics

scenarios.prove: source_check payload rejects unknown fields, invocation/locator-kind disagreement, advanced_search_sr bound to rfc_wfm_import_directory, RFC/WFM bound to advanced_search_import_directory, unsafe/nonabsolute manual paths and malformed profile/command identities; discovering checkpoint rejects any run/candidate/batch state while later phases require exact run revision plus closed stabilized candidate identity; candidate chronology/hash/size/mtime fields are bounded and typed; reappearance payload requires literal advanced_search_sr and exact UUID/revision fields; reappearance checkpoint accepts only both-null initial cursor or both-nonnull canonical eight-digit SR plus observation UUID resume cursor; malformed persisted values fail contract validation before execution/coalescing/recovery and never gain domain authority
